title: Jim Semivan opened the door for McGwier's visit to Bledsoe

tellings.quote: and he told me while I was there that Jim sovan said oh yeah you should let Bob in this should be interesting

plain: A visit to Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he has had UFO encounters and whose story appears in the book UFO of God, was approved by Jim Semivan, a retired CIA officer. Bob McGwier, an engineer who has worked as a CIA contractor, tells Michels that while he was there, Bledsoe told him Semivan had said, 'oh yeah you should let Bob in, this should be interesting.' McGwier tells it as a sign that people with intelligence backgrounds were quietly taking an interest in Bledsoe.
